form.label: CVE Explorer
form.description: Search and filter CVE records from the CVE List V5 database

search.query: | inputlookup cve_daily_summary.csv | eval _time=strptime(date_published, "%Y-%m-%d") | where _time > relative_time(now(), "-30d@d") | stats sum(cve_count) as count by date_published | eval _time=strptime(date_published, "%Y-%m-%d") | timechart span=1d sum(count) as count

`cveicu_index` sourcetype="cveicu:record" state="PUBLISHED" | eval severity=coalesce(cvss_v40_severity, cvss_v31_severity, "NONE") | search affected_vendor="$vendor_filter$" $severity_filter$ cwe_id="$cwe_filter$" | head 1000 | table cve_id title affected_vendor affected_product cvss_score severity cwe_id date_published | rename cve_id as "CVE ID", title as "Title", affected_vendor as "Vendor", affected_product as "Product", cvss_score as "CVSS", severity as "Severity", cwe_id as "CWE", date_published as "Published" | sort - Published
